description: Pistons facing east on the floor, powered by a redstone block put in the floor under them: the head pushing the player standing in front of it; the same on ice; walking west into a piston as its head comes out (pushed back while walking against it), then walking on as it retracts; a stone block pushed into the player.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
